sisi.depan: A long, narrow riveted metal tunnel recedes into the distance, ending at a heavy, sealed bulkhead door with a large wheel lock.
sisi.kanan: The right wall features a hissing steam valve mounted on a thick pipe and a small, barred side passage leading into darkness.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, the tunnel continues for a short distance before being blocked by a recent rockfall, with a large grated floor drain in the foreground.
sisi.kiri: Along the left wall is a sparking, open-faced electrical junction box and a rusted maintenance ladder bolted to the curved metal.

tengah: An overturned, rusted wheelbarrow lies on its side, its single wheel pointing towards the left wall.
atas: Thick, bundled pipes run the length of the curved ceiling, interspersed with flickering, caged amber work lights that cast long shadows.
